# Fashion-MNIST

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
```

## Phase I: Data exploration and visualisation

```{r phase1}
library(dslabs)

# Download the Fashion-MNIST files on the first run (about 30 MB)
dir.create("data/fashion", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

base_url <- "http://fashion-mnist.s3-website.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/"
files <- c("train-images-idx3-ubyte.gz",
           "train-labels-idx1-ubyte.gz",
           "t10k-images-idx3-ubyte.gz",
           "t10k-labels-idx1-ubyte.gz")

for (f in files) {
  path <- file.path("data/fashion", f)
  if (!file.exists(path)) {
    cat("Downloading", f, "...\n")
    download.file(paste0(base_url, f), destfile = path, mode = "wb")
  }
}

fashion_mnist <- read_mnist(path = "data/fashion")

# Training and test matrices with the images and their labels
X_train <- fashion_mnist$train$images
y_train <- fashion_mnist$train$labels

X_test <- fashion_mnist$test$images
y_test <- fashion_mnist$test$labels

class_names <- c('T-shirt/top', 'Trouser', 'Pullover', 'Dress', 'Coat',
                 'Sandal', 'Shirt', 'Sneaker', 'Bag', 'Ankle boot')

cat("\nTraining set:", dim(X_train)[1], "rows and", dim(X_train)[2], "columns\n")

# Count of each item
class_counts <- table(y_train)
names(class_counts) <- class_names
print(class_counts)

barplot(class_counts,
        main = "Items in the training set",
        ylab = "Number of images",
        col = "lightpink",
        border = "white",
        las = 2, # rotate the x labels so they are readable
        ylim = c(0, 8000))

# Sample of images: 3 x 3 grid
par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(1, 1, 3, 1))

for (i in 1:9) {
  image_matrix <- matrix(X_train[i, ], nrow = 28, ncol = 28)
  item_name <- class_names[y_train[i] + 1] # +1 because R indexes from 1

  image(1:28, 1:28, image_matrix[, 28:1],
        col = gray(255:0 / 255),  # white background instead of black
        axes = FALSE,
        main = paste("Item:", item_name))
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)

```

## Phase II: Pre-processing and normalisation

```{r phase2}
cat("Scale before normalisation: min =", min(X_train), ", max =", max(X_train), "\n")

# Normalise pixel values to [0, 1]
X_train_norm <- X_train / 255
X_test_norm <- X_test / 255

cat("Scale after normalisation: min =", min(X_train_norm), ", max =", max(X_train_norm), "\n")

# Labels as factors, so the SVM treats them as classes
y_train_factor <- as.factor(y_train)
y_test_factor <- as.factor(y_test)


# Before and after normalisation (the image should look the same)
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(1, 1, 4, 1))

img_original <- matrix(X_train[1, ], nrow = 28, ncol = 28)
img_normalised <- matrix(X_train_norm[1, ], nrow = 28, ncol = 28)

image(1:28, 1:28, img_original[, 28:1],
      col = gray(255:0 / 255),
      axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "",
      main = "Before normalisation\n(scale 0 to 255)")

image(1:28, 1:28, img_normalised[, 28:1],
      col = gray(255:0 / 255),
      axes = FALSE, xlab = "", ylab = "",
      main = "After normalisation\n(scale 0 to 1)")

par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)


# Pixel distributions before and after normalisation
pixel_values <- as.numeric(X_train_norm[1, ])

hist(as.numeric(X_train),
     main = "Pixel distribution before normalisation",
     xlab = "Pixel intensity",
     ylab = "Number of pixels",
     col = "lightpink",
     border = "white",
     breaks = 20)

hist(pixel_values,
     main = "Pixel distribution after normalisation",
     xlab = "Pixel intensity",
     ylab = "Number of pixels",
     col = "lightpink",
     border = "white",
     breaks = 20)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

```

## Phase III: Principal Component Analysis (PCA)

```{r phase3}
library(e1071)

# PART 1: how many principal components are needed?
# The test set stays untouched until the final evaluation, so this experiment uses
# 10,000 training images only: 8,000 for training and 2,000 for validation.
loop_train_idx <- 1:8000
loop_val_idx <- 8001:10000

X_loop_train <- X_train_norm[loop_train_idx, ]
y_loop_train <- y_train_factor[loop_train_idx]

X_loop_val <- X_train_norm[loop_val_idx, ]
y_loop_val <- y_train_factor[loop_val_idx]

# PCA on the 8,000 training images
pca_experiment <- prcomp(X_loop_train, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

# Cumulative explained variance: entry i is the share of the total variance (784 components)
# captured by the first i components
cum_var_experiment <- cumsum(pca_experiment$sdev^2) / sum(pca_experiment$sdev^2)

# Variance targets to test
variance_targets <- c(0.50, 0.60, 0.70, 0.80, 0.85, 0.90, 0.95)
results_table <- data.frame(Variance_Target = numeric(),
                            Num_PCs = numeric(),
                            Accuracy = numeric())

for (v in variance_targets) {
  cat("\nExperimental model with variance:", v * 100, "%\n")

  # Smallest number of PCs whose cumulative variance reaches the target
  num_comp <- which(cum_var_experiment >= v)[1]
  cat("Number of components (PCs):", num_comp, "\n")

  # Training scores on the first num_comp components
  X_tr_loop <- pca_experiment$x[, 1:num_comp]

  # Project the validation images onto the same components
  X_val_projected <- predict(pca_experiment, newdata = X_loop_val)[, 1:num_comp]

  # Radial-kernel SVM on the first num_comp PCs
  svm_loop <- svm(x = X_tr_loop,
                  y = y_loop_train,
                  type = "C-classification",
                  kernel = "radial")

  # Validation accuracy: correct predictions (diagonal) over the total
  preds_loop <- predict(svm_loop, X_val_projected)
  conf_loop <- table(Predicted = preds_loop, Actual = y_loop_val)
  acc <- sum(diag(conf_loop)) / sum(conf_loop)

  cat("Validation accuracy:", round(acc * 100, 2), "%\n")

  results_table <- rbind(results_table,
                         data.frame(Variance_Target = v,
                                    Num_PCs = num_comp,
                                    Accuracy = round(acc * 100, 2)))
}

print(results_table)


# PART 2: final model
# 80% of the variance is the best trade-off here, so the PCA is now fitted on all 60,000 training images

pca_final <- prcomp(X_train_norm, center = TRUE, scale. = FALSE)

cum_var_final <- cumsum(pca_final$sdev^2) / sum(pca_final$sdev^2)

target_variance <- 0.80
num_components_final <- which(cum_var_final >= target_variance)[1]

cat("\nTo keep", target_variance * 100, "% of the visual information of the clothing,\n")
cat("we need", num_components_final, "principal components.\n")

# Cumulative variance plot
par(mfrow = c(1, 1), mar = c(5, 4, 4, 2) + 0.1)

plot(cum_var_final, type = "l", lwd = 2, col = "blue",
     main = "Final PCA: cumulative variance",
     xlab = "Number of principal components",
     ylab = "Proportion of variance explained",
     xlim = c(0, 200))

abline(h = target_variance, col = "lightpink", lty = 2)
abline(v = num_components_final, col = "lightpink", lty = 2)
points(num_components_final, target_variance, col = "lightpink", pch = 19, cex = 1.5)

legend("bottomright", legend = paste(num_components_final, "PCs =", target_variance * 100, "% variance"),
       col = "lightpink", pch = 19, bty = "n")


# PART 3: final datasets

X_train_pca <- pca_final$x[, 1:num_components_final]

# Project the real test set (never used so far) onto the components learned from the 60,000 images
X_test_pca <- predict(pca_final, newdata = X_test_norm)[, 1:num_components_final]

cat("Final training set:", dim(X_train_pca)[1], "rows and", dim(X_train_pca)[2], "columns.\n")
cat("Final test set:", dim(X_test_pca)[1], "rows and", dim(X_test_pca)[2], "columns.\n")

```

## Phase IV: Classification with SVM

```{r phase4}
library(e1071)

# Cache the trained model so it is not retrained every time the notebook runs
model_file <- "svm_fashion_pca80.rds"

if (file.exists(model_file)) {
  cat("Saved Fashion-MNIST model found and loaded\n")
  svm_model <- readRDS(model_file)
} else {
  cat("Training a new SVM model for Fashion-MNIST...\n")

  svm_model <- svm(x = X_train_pca,
                   y = y_train_factor,
                   type = "C-classification",
                   kernel = "radial")

  cat("Training finished\n")
  saveRDS(svm_model, model_file)
}

# Predictions on the test images (projected onto the PCA space)
svm_predictions <- predict(svm_model, X_test_pca)

```

## Phase V: Evaluation

```{r phase5}
# Replace the labels 0 to 9 with the item names in the confusion matrix
predicted_names <- factor(svm_predictions, labels = class_names)
actual_names <- factor(y_test_factor, labels = class_names)

confusion_matrix <- table(Predicted = predicted_names, Actual = actual_names)

cat("\nConfusion matrix:\n")
print(confusion_matrix)

# Accuracy: correct predictions (diagonal) over all test images
correct <- sum(diag(confusion_matrix))
accuracy <- correct / length(y_test)

cat("\nThe model classified", correct, "of the", length(y_test), "test images correctly.\n")
cat("Overall accuracy:", round(accuracy * 100, 2), "%\n")
```
